requested.scope: whole repository, including shared LycheeUI integration
requested.execution: serial; fix and verify each round before starting the next

invariants: Later rounds exclude previously confirmed findings
Do not count speculative or repeated findings

completion.reason: These nine sequential finding/fix passes relied too heavily on confirming and fixing a new issue as their stopping condition. Their depth does not establish completion of the requested nine full-repository audits; the recorded fixes and verification remain valid.
completion.scopeMeaning: Per-pass scope entries list examined areas, not evidence of exhaustive coverage.

rounds.scope: Whole-repository loading, dependencies, service state ownership, event handoff and view lifetime
rounds.finding: A non-throttled failure of the in-flight search cleared a newer user request already held in pending.
rounds.fix: Continue the latest queued request through the existing scheduler; retain failure without retry when no newer request exists.

verification.before: Expected waiting after A timeout with queued B, got failed; native submission count remained 1
verification.after: 1674 assertions passed; timeout and generic failure submit B exactly once; existing no-pending failure and close cancellation cases pass

rounds.scope: Whole-repository callback, cancellation, native-input, preview and snapshot ownership; public shared-component layout contracts
rounds.finding: Rect retained its first parent and cached geometry after a caller reparented or re-laid out the region; even a zero-duration request could leave the wrong parent, position and size.
rounds.fix: Reconcile current parent, anchor and pixel geometry at Rect entry; preserve the existing per-frame write suppression and reusable state.

verification.after: 553 shared assertions and 3464 product assertions passed, including reparent, same-target reset and animation from caller-updated geometry

rounds.scope: Whole-repository cross-package data models, callback order, native listing state and UI draft ownership
rounds.finding: Cross-faction recreation could remove the old listing and fail to create its replacement; the later removal event then reset the edited cross-faction choice and cleared the failure message.
rounds.fix: Publish the actual listing state before Update returns even when recreation fails; retain the in-progress draft and keep submission errors across passive mode refreshes. Explicitly ending a listing still resets the next draft default.

verification.before: Actual Listing plus UI fixture failed: retained cross-faction value expected false, got true
verification.after: 4767 assertions passed; synchronous and delayed removal events preserve title, description, item level, cross-faction choice and error; retry and subsequent explicit ending remain correct

rounds.scope: Whole-repository service event/cache costs, result and application notifications, Notes, Floating and shared List/Panel/Motion/Native; tooltip layout writes
rounds.finding: RenderGroup measured the title and subtitle heights and positioned the subtitle before unconditionally repeating all three operations at the final leader-adjusted width.
rounds.fix: Remove the provisional measurements and placement; retain the final layout, complete member list, update timing and motion.

verification.workload: 40-member warmed tooltip; independent pre-fix fixture repeated opening 10 times
coverage: Regression failed before fix with expected 1 title-height read, got 2
All members retained
Warm subtitle/metric anchors and canvas height unchanged
Existing expanded, collapsed and scrolling cases pass

rounds.scope: Whole-repository batched reads, member and relation binding, service invalidation and hidden-reader lifetimes; core/static metadata and shared component work
rounds.finding: Every active clean relation-version query called GetTime even though the current time is used only by dirty rebuilds or inactive per-frame snapshots. Member binding and applicant lookup repeatedly entered this path.
rounds.fix: Return the existing version immediately for an active clean index; keep the original dirty and inactive paths. No new cache, scheduling or behavior change.

verification.after: Same actual Apply path counted 0 clock reads and unchanged social-directory reads
coverage: Friend/guild event invalidation
Active listing and create-view ownership
Hidden same-frame sharing and cleanup
Roster/applicant relationship markers and permission boundaries

rounds.scope: Whole-repository directory/string/geometry costs and cleanup; core specialization consumers, Notes/Transfer, roster and tooltip metadata, shared controls
rounds.finding: Player tooltips without localizedClass enumerated the entire class directory on every render; ordinary roster snapshots provide only the class token. The core already owns a reusable class directory.
rounds.fix: Use Specializations:Class only for the existing localized-class fallback; preserve provider names, unknown values and initial metadata loading. No additional cache.

verification.before: 20 repeated actual detail renders counted 40 GetClassInfo calls, regression expected 0
verification.after: GetClassInfo and GetNumClasses both 0 after warmup; existing text/height/metric-anchor comparisons pass
coverage: Explicit localized class wins
Unknown token remains unknown
Existing shared cache handles incomplete directory recovery
No change to refresh timing or motion

rounds.rejectedCandidate: Caching successful Delve atlas results would change the existing available/unavailable/available fallback behavior; kept the original path and tests.

rounds.scope: Whole-repository package manifests and load closure, service entry points, private UI state, shared APIs, build/sync boundaries and documentation
findings: Navigation labels no longer have an alpha-animation producer; their OnHide callback still stopped a nonexistent task and wrote the existing alpha value.
The canonical shared-library README simultaneously stated the current unlocked state and a stale frozen state.
rounds.fix: Remove only the unused navigation-label cleanup; replace the stale frozen claim with the current maintenance-scope reference to .lock.

coverage: Full reference search finds no navigation-label alpha-animation producer
Independent offline navigation and hover fixture counted zero label animation starts with alpha remaining 1
Existing navigation, underline, menu and close lifecycle regressions pass
README and .lock consistently describe the unlocked source; referenced .lock exists

rounds.scope: Whole-repository local references, public and fixture consumers, package load manifests, media paths, sync/build scripts and document links
findings: The group fixture retained nativeAvailable after its restore/use path had been removed; only its declaration remained.
The UI fixture bound Motion to a local M that it never read or exported.
rounds.fix: Delete the unused nativeAvailable declaration and remove only M from the UI fixture's alias declaration; preserve all fixtures and assertions.

coverage: Whole-repository/reference searches confirm both locals have no consumers
The removed expressions only read ordinary fixture table fields
All 53 TOC/XML load references exist
Canonical and embedded runtime file sets and bytes match, including 36 media files
Current maintained documentation has no missing local-link targets

rounds.scope: Whole-repository private-field consumers, dynamic WoW/XML globals, shared component options, migration paths, current specifications and package/tool/test boundaries
rounds.finding: The current design parameter table still specified result/application row heights of 84/40, contradicting its current-status section, detailed layout text and the implemented 76/36 constants.
rounds.fix: Correct the current table to 76/36. Keep runtime behavior, layout and historical evidence unchanged.

verification.method: Compare the edited table with Find.lua row constants and their C.List call sites, the detailed design section, and the existing UI row-height assertion.
retainedCandidates: Shared Motion and List consumer fields
Dynamic member-mark keys and metatable/options contracts

limits: Offline fixtures do not establish live API permissions, event order, rendering or whole-client performance.

layout.comparison: SHA-256 of each complete scene serialized with sorted JSON keys, against the pre-audit baseline
layout.coverage: Offline widget-tree geometry, text, colors, visibility and control state; not native engine pixels
